title: Reproducible paired evaluation of closed-loop therapy software: controller comparisons depend on sampling and scenario choices
description: Four alternatives are evaluated on the existing 4,608 paired trials each. The revised analysis retains 96 shared-parent blocks (four family variants and 12 scenarios per block), resampled within the three realised seeds. Bands use realised baseline energy and are retrospective. Endpoint fractions are final-time unweighted radial-node fractions over a 3,000 s horizon. No alternative demonstrates improved overall composite success. Bootstrap intervals and sign-flip tests are approximate exploratory summaries with explicit Latin-hypercube and sign-symmetry limitations.
